full_judgment: 14. Prosecution case was that PW 3 Maznu took out the dagger from the belly of deceased Rahima Khatun and PW 3 gave unimpeachable evidence that PW 3 Maznu clearly identified incriminating dagger, Material Exhibit-1 which he took out from the belly of deceased Rahima khatun and he denied defence suggestion that the dagger was not blood stained and the dagger was not that dagger (material Exhibit-1) which was produced in Court. True it is that in cross-examination   it came out from his mouth that the Daroga did not seize the dagger from him but non-seizure of incriminating dagger (material exhibit-I) from PW 3 cannot suggest any presumption that the incriminating dagger was not seized. The incriminating dagger was definitely seized by way of a seizure list and Seizure list demonstrates that the incriminating dagger was very much seized but may not he from PW 3 Maznu.
